verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is a laptop/desktop processor, and scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is not something a chip of this kind ships, so the story is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the pack shows the product or its software stack (Ryzen AI Software, Lemonade SDK, GAIA) offering a job scheduler, so the exception for a shipped wrong-axis capability does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
